paragraphs.text: Solphim is a Phyrexian Horror on New Phyrexia .

When Phyrexia reshaped the surface of Mirrodin, parts of the very land took on a mind of its own. Entire mountains began to move, becoming godlike Phyrexian creatures known as the Domini . No one knows what the Domini are or whether they think and desire the same way other Phyrexians do.

Solphim was forged in the Autonomous Furnace . She is an infernal giant in a gown of spears who carves mad commands into the metallic landscape with her molten-hot appendages, always urgent and always contradicting her previous orders.
